definition: official metadata states survey size 16,216 respondents

definition: foreign visitors age 15+ who visited Korea in the year and stayed 90 days or less; excludes foreign residents with Korean nationality, transit-only overnight cases, daigong/bodaeri traders, and captains/crew/military without tourism purpose
methodology: same-year 2024 population definition in official metadata
limitations: operational screening questions and raw eligibility variable names remain UNKNOWN

definition: foreign visitors waiting in regional airport/port departure lounges were randomly selected during the survey period
methodology: official metadata describes stratified sampling considering nationality, entry route, sex and age
limitations: exact within-location operational randomization and nonresponse replacement rules remain UNKNOWN

definition: planned total 16,000 allocated across 12 months at about 1,333/month; then country modified-proportional allocation using latest 3 months arrivals, country-to-airport/port proportional allocation, and country-by-sex-by-age allocation; sqrt proportional allocation used by country with minimum allocation for some groups
methodology: 4-stage allocation; sex/age allocation applied to countries with average monthly arrivals >=10,000, subject to exclusions
limitations: planned 16,000 differs from realized 16,216; monthly realized sample counts are not established here

definition: valid samples obtained under modified proportional allocation are post-weighted according to inbound proportions by country, month, sex and age
limitations: raw weight variable name, exact formula, calibration cells, treatment of zero/sparse cells, nonresponse adjustment and decimal precision remain UNKNOWN
